name: Instructor for Python products on many providers
gain: A typed Pydantic object back from several providers, with retries on validation errors. No measured number here.
how: Create the client with instructor.from_provider and pass response_model=YourModel. Keep the old parser as a fallback until a test shows the same keys come back.
replaces: json.loads and hand-written retries around a chat call in Python.
trade_offs: It adds a dependency between the product and its provider, where the provider's own structured outputs add none.
A retry on a failed extraction is another paid model call.
needs: Python and Pydantic. Version 1.17.0, MIT, released 9 Sep 2026.
usage_signal: Retries and output tokens on calls that are re-sent after a parse failure

gain_model.formula: parse_failure_rate * calls * cost_per_call = money lost to retries

inputs.name: parse_failure_rate
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: calls
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

test_recipe.what_to_compare: parse failures and schema errors, before and after

verify_rule: Parse-error logs and retried calls over 14 days after merge

change_recipe.how: Create the client with instructor.from_provider and pass response_model=YourModel. Keep the old parser as a fallback until a test shows the same keys come back.
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on
